title: Inside Bar Pattern with Escalation
entry_long: Inside Bar up pattern (ID3 up, ID2 pullback <open ID3, ID1 breakup) + EMA3>EMA8 + EMA3>EMA50
entry_short: Inside Bar down pattern (ID3 down, ID2 pullback >open ID3, ID1 breakdown) + EMA3<EMA8 + EMA3<EMA50
buildon_idea: Capped at 0.2 lots; validate flat-lot PF; consider 3+ lever sweep (spacing, grid-distance, TP, escalation frequency); multi-symbol/TF test
novelty_note: Classic inside-bar breakout; common pattern; moderate novelty

title: Price Action Doji + RSI Filter
entry_long: RSI<30 (oversold) + ID2 doji down (long wick) + ID1 bullish engulfing (close>ID2 open)
entry_short: RSI>70 (overbought) + ID2 doji up (long wick top) + ID1 bearish engulfing (close<ID2 open)
exit: grid 60pips + escalation, trailing stop 60/step 1, no SL/TP
buildon_idea: Capped 0.1; validate no-SL PF on flat lot; test RSI zones (20/80 vs 30/70); try pending-limit entries to avoid spread; escalation cap robust but test correlation if multi-symbol
novelty_note: RSI + doji overlay; decent signal quality; moderate novelty

title: Auto-Trend Line Breakout + RSI
entry_long: Trend line buy auto-generated (90 vs 45 candle high) + price crosses above + RSI<30
entry_short: Trend line sell auto-generated (90 vs 45 candle low) + price crosses below + RSI>70
exit: grid 100pips escalation, trailing stop 100/step 1, no SL/TP, max 50 orders
buildon_idea: Add position cap (50 is brake); flat-lot test critical; RSI zone logic tight (oversold/overbought only) = fewer entries = safer; escalation spacing validates well; test 2+ TF (H1 + 5m) to avoid false line breaks
novelty_note: Auto trend line generation novel; signal quality good but MC needed for 5yr validation; medium novelty

title: Multi-Timeframe Stochastic + Trend Line
entry_long: H1 RSI<30 + current TF: Stochastic main>signal in oversold + trend line break + EMA3>EMA200
entry_short: H1 RSI>70 + current TF: Stochastic main<signal in overbought + trend line break + EMA3<EMA200
exit: grid 15pips, escalation linear 0.01 per step, cap 50 orders, trailing stop 10/step 1
buildon_idea: Position cap at 50 = good risk brake; flat-lot test mandatory (Stochastic can whipsaw); swap Stochastic zones (20/80 vs 30/70) to tune entry frequency; test single-TF variant (drop H1 filter) to measure filter value; escalation frequency (every 1 order) is tight—widen to every 3-5
novelty_note: Multi-TF filter + auto trend line; modern approach; medium-high novelty

title: Multi-Group Scout: EMA + RSI Zones + Distance
entry_long: RSI<30 + EMA3>EMA8 + price within 300pips of EMA3
entry_short: RSI>70 + EMA3<EMA8 + price within 300pips of EMA3
exit: grid 60pips, escalation by RSI zone (70-100=+0.01, 51-69=fix 0.01, <50=+0.01), trailing stop 60/step 1
buildon_idea: Add SL via MC; distance filter (300pips) is aggressive—validate across symbols; RSI zone escalation logic (3-way split) adds nuance but test if simpler 2-zone works; cap 0.1 is good; test symbol correlation for portfolio fit (goal: <0.6 pairwise)
novelty_note: Zone-based lot escalation is novel; signal family (EMA+RSI+distance) is proven; medium-high novelty

title: Stochastic 9-3-3 Scalping
entry_long: Stochastic main<signal, cross in oversold (<20), EMA3>EMA200, RSI<30
entry_short: Stochastic main>signal, cross in overbought (>80), EMA3<EMA200, RSI>70
exit: grid 100pips, escalation 0.01 per level, trailing stop 100/step 1, or close at +5pips, max 30 orders, cut-loss at -1000
buildon_idea: Has cut-loss (-1000) and order cap (30) = risk controlled; flat-lot test with SL is baseline; escalation every 1 order is tight—test every 3-5; Stochastic zone (20/80 vs 30/70) tunable; scale distance (100pips) for other instruments; MC for robustness
novelty_note: Stochastic 9-3-3 is classic; scalping with zone filters is standard; low-medium novelty

title: Multi-Group Stochastic with Zone Escalation
entry_long: H1 RSI<30 + current TF: Stochastic main>signal in oversold, EMA3>EMA50, close>high[1]
entry_short: H1 RSI>70 + current TF: Stochastic main<signal in overbought, EMA3<EMA50, close<low[1]
exit: grid 15pips, escalation by RSI zone (70-100=+0.01, 51-69=fix 0.01), trailing stop 10/step 1, close-money 5pips, max 30 orders
buildon_idea: Zone-based escalation (3 bands) is novel; no SL is risk—add SL or MC; test if zone bands (70/51/30) are optimal or static 0.01 works; grid 15pips tight for 5m TF—validate spread impact; max 30 is good brake; multi-TF filter helps but test single-TF PF to measure value
novelty_note: Multi-TF stochastic + RSI zone escalation; medium novelty

title: Easy Hedging: EMA Crossover + Pending Hedge
entry_long: EMA3 cross above EMA8 + 3-candle pattern (down-down-up) + pending hedge sell 500pips below
entry_short: EMA3 cross below EMA8 + 3-candle pattern (up-up-down) + pending hedge buy 500pips above
exit: TP 500pips, SL 500pips, hedge cancels on main TP
buildon_idea: Already hedged = low risk structure; fixed lot (0.01+0.02) = no martingale; validate TP/SL 500pips spread appropriateness for other symbols (gold-suitable, tight for forex); hedging model caps upside but caps loss—test if removing hedge and using ATR SL outperforms; add ATR scaling for dynamic TP/SL; test symbol correlation with other EAs (should be low corr due to hedging mechanics)
novelty_note: Hedging strategy is mature; EMA+candlestick is proven; low-medium novelty but solid risk structure
